title: Sunday · the chair
logline: The lawn chair's first Sunday: Maria's aluminum-and-webbing chair on the dock, alone in the morning tier, with her in it at noon, empty again at dusk with a mug under it. The chair stays through 2027.

panels.composition: Tier 1: an aluminum lawn chair with faded webbing alone on the dock in morning light.

image.prompt: an old aluminum lawn chair with faded webbing alone on a wooden dock in morning light, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Morning

panels.composition: Tier 2: a woman with a dark braid in the chair, a mug, looking at the bay.

image.prompt: a woman with a dark braid sitting in an old lawn chair on a dock with a mug looking out at a bay, watercolor

panels.name: Noon

panels.composition: Tier 3: the chair empty at dusk, the mug under it, the bay pink.

image.prompt: an empty old lawn chair on a dock at dusk with a mug beneath it and a pink bay, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Dusk

notes: The lawn chair (objects.md). From July 2009 on.
